scientific_integrity: Complete proof is supplied in RESULT.md; the checker uses finite symbolic, rational, and numerical diagnostics only. Broad interval-moment methods could imply aspects of this specialized result; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact observations; known distinct turnover rates and baseline equilibrium; a single A–B–A excursion with a common nonzero positive cross-tissue isotope contrast. A fourth-power Jacobian determinant loss occurs as excursion length vanishes; no noise precision, field calibration, or extension to multiple diet excursions is proved.
title: Three isotope clocks identify an uncalibrated temporary diet excursion
